reden: Not detected. The report’s only reentrancy finding is about _handleTrade refund allowing a share-lock bypass and JIT reward capture. It does not mention reentering createCred during the auto-buy refund, overwriting creds[credIdCounter] before increment, or exploiting multiple bonding curves to drain funds. The code path and fix differ: H-06 requires guarding createCred (or CEI around its internal buy) to prevent overwriting before credIdCounter increments; the report focuses on lastTradeTimestamp order/nonReentrancy in _handleTrade. Fixing the report’s issue (e.g., set timestamp before refund or nonReentrant on _handleTrade) would not necessarily fix the createCred overwrite/arbitrage, so these are different vulnerabilities.
